section2_ablation_summary.design_note: The ExactState is deliberately EXCLUDED from every key. Including it would make the ablation vacuous, because in this universe each of the 2,234 post-R2 ExactStates is reached by exactly one boundary, so any key containing the state separates everything regardless of decoration.
section2_ablation_summary.greedy_caveat: The greedy subset SEPARATES this finite universe's boundaries into relation-homogeneous groups; it does NOT let one COMPUTE the relations from their definitions. Chaining is defined as r1_target_orbit == r2_source_orbit, so both of those fields are structurally required even though the greedy search drops r1_target_orbit. Separating-minimality and structural-minimality are different notions and the greedy result is the weaker one.
